thread:
jia: Quick sync — followup from yesterday's RFC on page-hint signals between allocator <-> evictor. We need to pick a handshake model. Two short options:
- push-only: allocator emits hints into a bounded queue, evictor polls/drains. Simple, lower latency for hotness but can overload evictor and increase tail latency.
- subscribe/event: evictor subscribes, allocator notifies on transitions; backpressure via acks. More complex but safer for multi-tenant fairness.

kevin: Can you share the perf numbers we saw in the PoC? how bad is the polling overhead?

jia: PoC numbers (staging, 8xA100, synthetic mix): polling @5ms/coalesce => +3-5ms p99 per request under 80% load. Event mode w/ acks => negligible p50, p99 uplift ~1ms due to ack roundtrip. Main cost is contention when queue grows >2k entries.

samir: We should think about tenant fairness. If allocator just floods hints, noisy tenant can starve others' evictor cycles. Backpressure + per-tenant budgeting needed. Also consider accounting hints as "soft reservations" so evictor can prioritize.

ashley: What about a hybrid: allocator pushes hints but we do coalescing + an adaptive delay based on queue depth. Evictor exposes an async pull API as well for catch-up. That keeps fast-path simple but allows flow-control when under pressure.

jia: sketch of a minimal API we discussed:
```c
// lightweight hint
struct PageHint { uint64_t addr; uint32_t len; uint8_t hotness; };
// allocator -> hint queue (bounded)
void post_pagehint(PageHint h);
// evictor registers consumer and ack interface
void register_hint_consumer(consumer_id, callback_on_drain);
```

maria: tests we need: (1) overload test with mixed tenants, (2) p99 regression test, (3) correctness test for eviction decisions when hints are coalesced/lost. Also add telemetry: hint_loss_count, queue_depth_hist, hint_latency_ms.

deploy-bot: rolling a canary branch named `pagehint-handshake-proto` to staging now :rocket:

samir: Also suggest an opt-in per-deployment flag. Default to hybrid coalescing mode; opt into strict ack-mode for enterprise/dedicated where fairness is critical.

jia: Agreed. Proposed resolution: implement hybrid push/coalesce with bounded queue + optional ack-mode behind a feature flag. Deliverables: prototype handshake + perf harness + the 3 tests maria listed. Owner: me. Plan to canary next Wed.

ashley: sounds good. I'll pair on the coalescing logic and write the queue invariants.

maria: i'll add the perf jobs and alerting (regressions >1ms p99).

jia: thanks — creating a brief RFC follow-up doc and linking the PR shortly. If anyone has objections, speak now, otherwise we'll move forward. :+1:
